caseName: New York Mobile Homes Assn. v. Steckel
caseNameFull: NEW YORK MOBILE HOMES ASSN. Et Al. v. STECKEL, SUPERVISOR OF THE TOWN OF CHILI, Et Al.
attorneys: William, L. Clay for appellants., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and Ruth Kessler Toch, Assistant Solicitor General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Whittaker took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
